run_cpp_tests_with_tofill: run C++ unit tests by filling //TOFILL placeholders with generated function code and executing compiled binaries
compile_and_execute_cpp_test: compile a C++ test file with a filled function and execute the resulting binary with a configurable timeout
evaluate_test_output: parse Google Test output to extract total test count, pass status, and number of failures
create_cpp_test_runner: create a CppEvosuiteTestRunner instance with custom timeout, temp folder, and subfolder configuration
process_cpp_function_name: extract and detokenize a C++ function name using the LangProcessor for code replacement
